footerNote: All figures are GAAP, in $ millions unless noted; EPS is shown exactly as reported in the release — GAAP diluted EPS of $8.25 — on a pre-split basis (Broadcom's 10-for-1 stock split took effect in October 2024). Free cash flow is cash from operations of $4,828M less $105M of capital expenditures. This was the last quarter before VMware was consolidated: the acquisition closed on November 22, 2023, after the October 29, 2023 quarter end, so no VMware revenue is included.

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP)
kpis.note: vs $7.83 a year ago — pre-split, as reported

oneTimers: GAAP profit carries $786M of amortization of acquisition-related intangible assets ($438M inside cost of revenue and $348M inside operating expenses) — a bookkeeping charge, not cash. On Broadcom's non-GAAP view, net income was $4,810M instead of $3,524M.
Stock-based compensation expense was $638M in the quarter ($62M in cost of revenue, $448M in research and development and $128M in selling, general and administrative).
otherDetail: Interest expense of $405M on Broadcom's debt, partly offset by $132M of other income, net — a net -$273M below operating profit.

takeaways.text: Quarterly revenue of $9,295M was up just 4% YoY, but fiscal 2023 revenue hit a record $35,819M, up 8%, and free cash flow was a record $17.6B — 49% of revenue.
takeaways.title: A record year, a quiet quarter

takeaways.text: Broadcom closed the VMware acquisition on November 22, 2023 — after this quarter ended — and guided fiscal 2024 revenue to approximately $50B including VMware, up about 40%.
takeaways.title: VMware changes everything next year

takeaways.text: Free cash flow was $4,723M in the quarter — 51% of revenue — and Broadcom raised its quarterly dividend by 14% to $5.25 a share for fiscal 2024.
takeaways.title: Half of revenue became free cash

verdict: Broadcom closed its pre-VMware era with revenue up 4% to $9.3B and $3.5B of profit — then guided to about $50B of revenue in fiscal 2024 with VMware in the fold.
